name: project-resolver
description: AI agent workflow orchestration for project planning, GitHub-first development, independent verification and multi-PR software delivery.

interface.longDescription: Coordinate real project delivery with reusable AI agent skills. Start from approved Owner goals, use existing GitHub repositories and tools, delegate bounded implementation to capable agents, review exact PR evidence, require independent verification when appropriate, and continue authorized multi-step work through completion. Works with the existing Project Resolver repository; not a hosted agent runner or automatic scheduler.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Project Resolver to organize my approved project objective into a GitHub-first multi-step workflow. Reuse existing tools and Issues, delegate implementation, require independent verification where needed, and continue only authorized stages through completed results.
